newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,330 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,330 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,330 contracts compared with 3,481 overnight Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 47 wheat, 862 corn, 340 soybean, 8 soymeal, two soyoil, one oat, 27 corn calls, 35 corn puts and eight soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 1/2 to one cent higher, corn was two to three cents higher and soybeans were two to 4-1/2 cents higher.
